newsitem.title: UK: Ukraine's Mityukov sees marginal 2nd half growth.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Mityukov sees marginal 2nd half growth.

text.p: Ukrainian Finance Minister Ihor Mityukov said he hoped to see GDP growth of 0.3 to 0.5 percent in the second half of 1997 after negative growth of 10 percent in 1996.
"Some sectors of the economy were still declining in the first quarter of the year, but in some sectors we saw there really are signs of growth," he told Reuters Financial Television.
"We hope that the second half of this year will be the period of starting economic growth. At least we hope it will be 0.3 to 0.5 percent GDP growth...by the end of December."

Ukraine's economy is forecast to show zero growth this year. Mityukov, in London for the annual meeting of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), said there were signs that sectors such as food-processing and export-oriented machinery and steel products were growing.
"We hope that they will support the overall growth process," he added.
